questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A worker was injured when a machine he was using on the job malfunctioned. The worker brought a federal diversity action against both the machine's manufacturer and the company responsible for the machine's maintenance. At trial, the worker submitted a proposed jury instruction on negligence. The court did not accept the proposed instruction and instead gave a negligence instruction that the worker's attorney believed was less favorable and legally incorrect. The attorney did not object to the negligence instruction before it was given. The jury returned a verdict for the defendants.
The worker has moved for a new trial on the ground that the court's negligence instruction was improper.
What argument has the best chance of persuading the court to grant the motion?

choices.A: Issues of law can be raised at any time.
choices.B: The court's negligence instruction was incorrect and the worker's objection to it was preserved when he submitted his proposed negligence instruction.
choices.C: The court's negligence instruction was plain error that affected the worker's substantial rights.
choices.D: The need for a formal objection to a judicial ruling in order to preserve an argument has been eliminated in the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.

A party must generally raise a formal objection at trial to preserve and challenge an error in a post-trial motion (eg, motion for new trial) or on appeal. An error in the jury instructions is preserved if the objection was raised either:

  • at the close of evidence — by filing a written request for a proposed instruction and obtaining a definitive ruling from the court on the record or
  • before the court instructed the jury and before closing arguments — by clearly identifying, and stating the grounds for, the objection on the record.

If a party failed to do so, the challenged error can only be reviewed for plain error (Choice D). Under a plain error review, a motion for new trial will be granted if the movant shows that an obvious error affected a substantial right and the fairness of judicial proceedings—eg, a jury instruction that misstated the law.

Here, the worker submitted a proposed jury instruction on negligence. That proposal was not accepted by the court, but it was not definitively denied on the record (no preserved error) (Choice B). And though the worker's attorney disagreed with the court's instruction, the attorney did not object to it on the record (no preserved error). But since the attorney believed that the court's instruction was legally incorrect, the best argument to support the motion for new trial is that the instruction was plain error that affected the worker's substantial rights.

(Choice A) Most issues—including issues of law—must be raised at trial before they can be raised post-trial (eg, improper jury instruction). Only certain issues can be raised at any time (eg, lack of subject-matter jurisdiction or standing).

📌 Educational Objective

A party must generally raise a formal objection at trial to preserve his/her right to challenge an error in a post-trial motion or on appeal. But if a party fails to do so, the challenged error can still be reviewed for plain error—ie, an obvious error that affected a substantial right and the fairness of judicial proceedings.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 51 (preserving error regarding requests for, and objections to, jury instructions).
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 59, 61 (motion and standard for new trial).

questions.zh-explanation:
陪审团指示与错误保存

Civil Procedure: Jury Instructions & Error Preservation

💡 核心考点：未异议指示的救济途径

Plain Error Review under FRCP 51(d)(2)

当当事人在庭审中未能对法院的陪审团指示提出有效异议时，事后（如申请新审判或上诉）挑战该指示的唯一途径是证明其构成明显错误 (Plain Error)。

异议状态 保存条件 (Preservation) 审查标准 (Review Standard)
已保存错误
(Preserved)		 在指示给陪审团前，在记录上提出明确异议并说明理由；或提交书面申请且法院在记录上做出终局拒绝裁决。 滥用裁量权 (Abuse of Discretion) / 法律问题自始审查 (De Novo)
未保存错误
(Unpreserved)		 未在法庭指示前提出异议，且未获得法院对书面申请的终局拒绝裁决。 明显错误标准
(Plain Error Standard)
陪审团指示错误审查决策流 (FRCP 51)
1. 是否提交了书面指示申请，且法院在记录上做出了终局裁决 (Definitive Ruling)？
↓ 否
2. 是否在陪审团接受指示前，在记录上明确提出异议 (Clearly Objected)？
↓ 否 (本案情况：律师认为错误但未异议)
3. 结论：错误未被保存 (Error Not Preserved)
↓ 寻求救济
4. 必须证明存在影响实质性权利的明显错误 (Plain Error)

⚖️ 法律依据与深度解析

1
根据 FRCP 51(c)，当事人若想保存对陪审团指示的异议，必须在法庭宣读指示前、结案陈词前，在记录上提出异议，并清晰说明理由。本案中，原告律师虽然主观认为指示不正确，但未在法庭宣读前提出异议。
2
原告虽曾提交过一份 negligence 指示申请，但法院未采纳。根据 FRCP 51(d)(1)(B)，仅提交申请不足以保存异议，除非法院在记录上做出了明确的拒绝裁决 (Definitive Ruling on the record)。本案中法院只是“未接受”，并无记录在案的终局拒绝，因此异议未保存。
3
对于未保存的陪审团指示错误，根据 FRCP 51(d)(2)，法院只有在错误属于明显错误 (Plain Error) 且影响实质性权利 (Affected Substantial Rights) 时，才能在事后（如新审判动议 FRCP 59 中）予以纠正。
⚠️ 常见高频陷阱：
很多考生误以为“只要我向法庭提交过正确的指示草案，法庭用了错误的，我就自动保存了异议权”。这是错误的！
仅仅提交申请（Proposed Instruction）不能免除你在法庭给出错误指示时进行口头异议的义务，除非法庭此前已经对你的申请做出了明确记录在案的拒绝。

🔄 延伸场景对比 (What-if)

如果：在庭审中，原告提交了 negligence 指示申请，法官在法庭记录上明确表示：“我拒绝原告的申请，且该决定是终局的，原告无需再重复异议。”

结果：此时原告的异议已被保存 (Preserved)。在申请新审判时，原告只需证明该指示存在普通法律错误（无需达到“明显错误”的极高门槛）即可获得新审判。

✅ 正确选项与干扰项逐项剖析

Choice C is correct: The court's negligence instruction was plain error that affected the worker's substantial rights.
【正确】由于原告律师未能及时在记录上对陪审团指示提出异议，该错误未被保存。因此，原告在申请新审判时，能说服法院的唯一且最佳论点是：该指示存在“明显错误”（Plain Error），且该错误直接影响了原告的实质性权利（即导致了不公正的判决结果）。
Choice A is wrong: Issues of law can be raised at any time.
【错误】法律问题并非随时可以提出。绝大多数法律问题（包括陪审团指示、证据可采性等）必须在庭审中及时提出异议以保存记录，否则事后将丧失挑战的权利。只有极少数问题（如联邦法院的“事物管辖权” Subject-Matter Jurisdiction）才可以在诉讼的任何阶段随时提出。
Choice B is wrong: The court's negligence instruction was incorrect and the worker's objection to it was preserved when he submitted his proposed negligence instruction.
【错误】如前所述，仅仅提交一份拟定的指示申请，在没有得到法院记录在案的终局拒绝裁决的情况下，不能自动保存对最终给出的错误指示的异议。
Choice D is wrong: The need for a formal objection to a judicial ruling in order to preserve an argument has been eliminated in the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure.
【错误】混淆了概念。虽然 FRCP 46 废除了传统的“正式例外登记 (Formal Exception)”制度，但当事人在法庭做出裁决或给予指示时，仍然必须表明自己的反对立场及理由（即提出 Objection），否则无法保存上诉或事后救济的权利。
🎓 MBE 提分秘籍 (Exam Trick)：
在联邦民诉法（Civ Pro）中，看到“Jury Instruction Error”且“No Objection at trial”的组合，脑海中要瞬间弹出唯一解：Plain Error Review (明显错误审查)。这是未保存错误的唯一救命稻草！

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A man was apprehended for illegally crossing the U.S. border. The man was held at a detention facility for over a month before the government realized that he was a U.S. citizen. After he was released, the man filed a complaint in federal court against the government under a federal statute that waives the federal government's immunity in these types of suits. The man sought $100,000 in damages and demanded a jury trial.
At the close of evidence at trial, the government and the man both submitted proposed jury instructions. The court decided to hear the parties' closing arguments before ruling on which instructions to use. Both parties made their closing arguments. The court then informed the parties outside the jury's presence of its proposed instructions, which differed significantly from the instructions proposed by the parties. Both parties objected on the record.
Did the court err in providing its proposed jury instructions in this manner?

choices.A: No, because the court has complete authority to decide when and how to provide jury instructions.
choices.B: No, because the court need not to inform the parties of its proposed instructions until after closing arguments.
choices.C: Yes, because the court failed to inform the parties of its proposed instructions and give them an opportunity to object before closing arguments.
choices.D: Yes, because the court failed to instruct the jury before closing arguments.

questions.explanation:
Jury instructions
(FRCP 51)
Requests Party:
  • must file request by close of evidence unless earlier, reasonable deadline set by court
  • may file request after close of evidence when:
    • request relates to issue that party could not have reasonably anticipated by deadline or
    • court permits late submission related to any issue
Instructions Court:
  • must inform parties of proposed instructions before instructing jury & closing arguments
  • must allow parties to object on record & outside jury's presence before instructing jury & closing arguments
  • may consider objection made after court instructs jury if instruction constituted plain error
  • may instruct jury at any time before discharge
Objections Party:
  • must distinctly state objection & its grounds on record
  • must object at court-appointed time or promptly after learning of proposed instruction
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

In a jury trial, the court must provide jury instructions that advise jurors on their deliberation procedures and the applicable law. The court has the ultimate authority to decide when and how to provide jury instructions so long as it complies with the requirements of Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP 51) (Choice A). Under FRCP 51, the court:

  • may instruct the jury at any time before the jury is discharged—ie, released from its duties in the case
  • must inform the parties of its proposed instructions before it instructs the jury and the parties give their closing arguments and
  • must give the parties an opportunity to object on the record and outside the presence of the jury before the instructions and closing arguments are delivered to the jury.

Here, the court properly informed the parties of its proposed instructions and gave them an opportunity to object before it instructed the jury. But the court erred in failing to do so before closing arguments (Choice B). As a result, the parties could not tailor their closing arguments to the applicable law provided in the court's jury instructions.

(Choice D) The court did not err in failing to instruct the jury before the parties gave their closing arguments because a court may instruct the jury at any time before the jury is discharged. Instead, the court erred in failing to inform the parties of its proposed instructions and give them an opportunity to object before closing arguments.

📌 Educational Objective

In a jury trial, a court (1) may instruct the jury at any time before the jury is discharged, (2) must inform the parties of its proposed instructions before instructing the jury and closing arguments, and (3) must allow the parties to object on the record and outside the presence of the jury before the instructions and closing arguments are delivered.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 51(b) (court requirements for providing jury instructions).

在庭审的证据出示阶段结束时，政府和该男子双方都提交了建议的陪审团指令。法院决定在裁定使用哪些指令之前，先听取双方的最后陈述。双方都作了最后陈述。随后，法院在陪审团不在场的情况下，将其建议的指令告知双方，这些指令与双方所建议的指令有显著不同。双方都正式提出了反对意见。

法院以这种方式提供其建议的陪审团指令，是否存在错误？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为法院在指示陪审团之前，已给予双方机会对其建议的指令提出反对。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为法院拥有完全的权力来决定何时以及如何提供建议的陪审团指令。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为法院未能在最后陈述之前，将其建议的指令告知双方，并给予他们提出反对的机会。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为法院未能在最后陈述之前指示陪审团。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

民事诉讼法 (Civil Procedure) - 陪审团指令
正确答案：C 法院犯了错误。因为法院未能在双方进行最后陈述 (Closing Arguments) 之前，告知双方其拟定的陪审团指令并给予反对机会。
核心考点：FRCP 51(b)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第51条，法院在处理陪审团指令 (Jury Instructions) 时必须遵守严格的时间线：

1.
告知义务 (Inform):
法院必须在指示陪审团和当事人进行最后陈述之前，将其拟采用的指令告知当事人。
2.
反对机会 (Opportunity to Object):
法院必须在指示陪审团和最后陈述之前，给予当事人在陪审团不在场的情况下提出反对意见的机会。

📝 案情分析

本题的关键在于时间顺序：

  1. 双方提交建议指令。
  2. 法院让双方先进行最后陈述 (Closing Arguments)。
  3. 陈述结束后，法院才告知其拟定的指令（且与双方建议的不同）。

为什么这是错误的？
律师在做最后陈述时，需要根据法院即将告诉陪审团的法律规则来构建论点。如果律师不知道法院最终会使用什么法律指令，他们就无法有效地向陪审团辩论案情。因此，FRCP 51 要求必须先定指令，再做陈述。

⚠️ 考试陷阱 (Distinction)
注意区分“告知指令内容”和“向陪审团宣读指令”的时间点：
  • 告知律师 (Notice): 必须在最后陈述之前。
  • 宣读指令 (Instructing the Jury): 可以在最后陈述之前，也可以在之后（只要在陪审团解散前即可）。

选项 D 错误的原因就在于此：法院没有义务必须在最后陈述前宣读指令，但有义务在最后陈述前告知指令内容。

A patent holder brought a patent infringement action, which involves triable jury issues, in federal court against a licensee of the patent. The patent holder believed that a jury would be more sympathetic to his claims than a judge and asked his lawyer to obtain a jury trial.
What should the lawyer do to secure the patent holder's right to a jury trial?

choices.A: File and serve a complaint that includes a jury trial demand.
choices.B: File and serve a jury trial demand at the close of discovery.
choices.C: File and serve a jury trial demand within 30 days after the close of the pleadings.
choices.D: Make a jury trial demand at the initial pretrial conference.

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 38, a party may demand a jury trial on any triable jury issue by:

  • serving the other parties with a written jury trial demand no later than 14 days after the last pleading directed to that issue is served and
  • filing the jury trial demand with the court within a reasonable time after service of the demand.*

The demand can be included in a pleading or set forth in a separate document. And the right to a jury trial is waived if the above requirements are not met. The lawyer here can therefore secure a jury trial by including the jury trial demand in a filed and served complaint—ie, the pleading that starts a case.

*A proper jury trial demand may be withdrawn later, but only with the other parties' consent.

(Choice A) File and serve a complaint that includes a jury trial demand.

(Choice B) Discovery is a pretrial phase of a lawsuit during which the parties are compelled to disclose information related to the case. Since this is a lengthy process that often continues more than 14 days after the last pleading is served, a jury trial demand filed and served at the close of discovery would likely be untimely.

(Choice C) A jury trial demand must be served within 14 (not 30) days after the last pleading directed to the triable issue is served. And the demand would be even more untimely if the last pleading concerning the triable issue was served before pleadings closed.

(Choice D) An initial pretrial conference is typically held several weeks after the pleadings have closed, so a jury trial demand made at that conference would likely be untimely.

📌 Educational Objective

A party may secure the right to a jury trial on any triable jury issue by (1) serving the other parties with a written jury trial demand no later than 14 days after the last pleading directed to the issue is served and (2) filing the jury trial demand with the court within a reasonable time after service of the demand.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 38 (jury trial demand).

questions.question:
The buyer of a business brought a diversity action against the seller in federal court seeking an injunction for breach of a covenant not to compete that had been included in their sales contract. The seller served his answer and a counterclaim seeking $8,000 in damages for missed installment payments under the contract. Twenty-one days later, the buyer served an answer to the counterclaim. Ten days after the buyer served his answer, the seller served a jury trial demand with regard to the counterclaim. The demand was then filed with the court.
Is the seller entitled to a jury trial on his counterclaim?

choices.A: No, because the seller is the plaintiff with regard to the counterclaim and the right to a jury trial belongs to the defendant.
choices.B: No, because the seller's jury trial demand was untimely.
choices.C: Yes, because the seller, as the defendant with regard to the original claim, has the right to demand a jury trial.
choices.D: Yes, because the seller is seeking damages from the buyer.

questions.explanation:
Right to jury trial in civil case
Right
  • Legal claim – seeks monetary remedy to compensate for loss (eg, tort/contract damages)
AND
  • > $20 in controversy
No right
  • Equitable claim – seeks nonmonetary remedy (eg, injunction, specific performance) since legal remedy is inadequate
OR
  • ≤ $20 in controversy

Under the Seventh Amendment, a party is entitled to a jury trial in an action at law (i.e., an action for damages) so long as the amount in controversy exceeds $20. And under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 38(b), any party (i.e., plaintiff or defendant) may demand a jury trial (Choice A). To properly do so, a party must:

  • serve the other parties with a written demand for a jury trial within 14 days after the last pleading directed to the issue (usually the defendant's answer) is served and
  • file the demand with the court within a reasonable time after service of the demand.

A party waives the right to a jury trial by failing to do so.

Here, the seller demanded a jury trial on the issue of the missed installment payments, pled in his counterclaim. The last pleading directed to that issue was the buyer's answer, and the seller timely served the buyer with the jury trial demand 10 days (i.e., within 14 days) after that answer was served (Choice B). And either party may demand a jury trial on this issue since the seller is seeking $8,000 in damages from the buyer (i.e., an action at law seeking more than $20). Therefore, the seller is entitled to a jury trial on his counterclaim.

(Choice C) There is no right to a jury trial in actions in equity (e.g., request for injunction). And the seller's status as the defendant with regard to the original claim (i.e., complaint) is irrelevant as to his right to demand a jury trial on the counterclaim. Further, the buyer could also demand a jury trial on the counterclaim.

📌 Educational Objective

The right to a jury trial exists in actions at law (i.e., actions for damages). And any party is entitled to demand a jury trial.

📚 References
  • U.S. Const. amend. VII (right to a jury trial).
  • Feltner v. Columbia Pictures Television, Inc., 523 U.S. 340, 347–48 (1998) (explaining that the Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial only applies in legal, not equitable, actions).
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 38(b) (setting forth procedure for any party to demand a jury trial when an issue is triable by a jury).

questions.zh-explanation:
民事诉讼法：陪审团审判权

Civil Procedure: Right to Jury Trial

💡 核心考点：反诉中的陪审团审判权

The Seventh Amendment & FRCP 38 Jury Demand

在联邦民事诉讼中，当原告提起衡平法诉讼，而被告提起普通法反诉时，被告是否有权就其反诉请求陪审团审判？如何计算提出陪审团要求的法定期限？

诉讼请求类型 救济手段 (Remedy) 陪审团审判权
普通法诉讼 (Law) 金钱赔偿 (Monetary) 有权 (争议金额 > $20)
衡平法诉讼 (Equity) 禁令、特定履行等 无权 (由法官审判)
⏳ 诉讼流程与陪审团请求时效图解
1. 买方起诉 (原诉)
诉求：禁令 (Injunction) ➔ 衡平法诉求，无陪审团权
▼
2. 卖方答辩并提起反诉 (Counterclaim)
诉求：$8,000 金钱赔偿 ➔ 普通法诉求，产生陪审团权
▼
3. 买方对反诉做出答辩 (Answer to Counterclaim)
时间点：第 0 天 ➔ 针对该争议焦点的“最后一份诉状”
▼
4. 卖方送达陪审团要求 (Jury Demand)
时间点：第 10 天 ➔ 未超 14 天时限，程序合法有效！

⚖️ 法律依据与递进解析

1
实体权利分析： 根据美国宪法第七修正案（Seventh Amendment），在普通法诉讼（action at law）中，只要争议金额超过 $20，当事人即享有陪审团审判的权利。本案中卖方的反诉请求为 $8,000 的金钱赔偿，属于典型的普通法诉求，因此实体上享有陪审团审判权。
2
程序时效分析： 根据联邦民事诉讼规则 FRCP 38(b)，任何一方当事人若想行使陪审团审判权，必须在针对该争议焦点的最后一份诉状（pleading）送达后 14 天内，向对方送达书面的陪审团审判要求，并在合理时间内向法院备案。
3
时限起算点锁定： 针对卖方反诉（Counterclaim）这一争议焦点的最后一份诉状，是买方针对该反诉做出的答辩状（Answer to Counterclaim）。卖方在买方送达答辩状后的第 10 天送达了陪审团要求，完全符合 14 天的法定时限。
⚠️ 核心陷阱提示： 许多考生会误以为时限应从卖方自己提交反诉或最初的起诉状起算。记住，FRCP 38(b) 的 14 天起算点是“最后一份针对该争议焦点的诉状” (last pleading directed to the issue)。在反诉中，这通常是对方针对反诉做出的答辩状（Answer），而非反诉状本身！

🔄 拓展场景：如果诉讼请求混合怎么办？

如果原告在同一诉讼中既请求金钱赔偿（普通法），又请求禁令（衡平法），联邦法院将如何处理？
【Beacon Theatres 规则】： 法院必须先由陪审团对普通法事实问题进行审判，然后再由法官解决衡平法救济问题。法官在做出衡平法裁决时，必须受陪审团此前所做事实认定的约束。

✅ 正确选项与干扰项逐项剖析

Choice D 正确：Yes, because the seller is seeking damages from the buyer.
解析：卖方的反诉请求是 $8,000 的金钱赔偿（damages），这属于普通法诉求（action at law），且金额远超 $20。因此，卖方在实体法上有权就该反诉请求陪审团审判。在程序上，其要求在买方答辩后 10 天内提出，未超 14 天时限，完全合法。
Choice A 错误：No, because the seller is the plaintiff with regard to the counterclaim...
解析：该选项声称只有被告才有权要求陪审团。这是对法律的严重误解。根据 FRCP 38(b)，任何一方当事人（any party，无论是原告还是被告）只要符合条件，都可以依法提出陪审团审判要求。
Choice B 错误：No, because the seller's jury trial demand was untimely.
解析：该选项认为卖方的请求超时。实际上，针对反诉这一焦点的最后一份诉状是买方的答辩状。卖方在买方答辩后 10 天提出请求，处于 14 天的法定宽限期内，因此是及时的（timely）。
Choice C 错误：Yes, because the seller, as the defendant with regard to the original claim...
解析：虽然结论正确（Yes），但其推理错误。卖方是否有权对反诉要求陪审团，取决于反诉本身的性质（是否为普通法诉求），而与其在原诉中作为被告的身份无关。此外，原诉（禁令）本身是衡平法诉讼，根本不产生陪审团审判权。
🎓 MBE 提分秘籍 (Exam Trick)： 在判断陪审团权利时，牢记两步法：
  1. 看救济：只要要钱（Damages > $20），就有权；只要要禁令/特定履行，就无权。
  2. 算时间：找针对该问题的“最后一份诉状”（通常是 Answer），往后数 14 天。

questions.question:
Before the close of evidence in a federal defamation trial, the plaintiff and the defendant each submitted proposed jury instructions on the elements of defamation. Before the trial judge instructed the jury and the parties gave their closing arguments, the trial judge informed the parties of the instructions she would give, which did not include the plaintiff's proposed instructions but did include the defendant's instructions. The plaintiff objected, but the judge overruled the objection. The judge then instructed the jury before the parties gave their closing arguments. The plaintiff objected again, which the judge overruled. The jury returned a verdict for the defendant, and the judge entered judgment on the verdict.
The plaintiff has appealed the verdict on the ground that the trial judge erred when she instructed the jury before closing arguments.
Is the appellate court likely to find that the trial judge erred?

choices.A: No, because the trial judge may instruct the jury before closing arguments.
choices.B: No, because the trial judge must instruct the jury before closing arguments.
choices.C: Yes, because the trial judge must instruct the jury after closing arguments.
choices.D: Yes, because the trial judge must instruct the jury before the close of evidence.

In a jury trial, the court must provide jury instructions that advise jurors on their deliberation procedures and the applicable law. Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 51 sets forth the following requirements for instructing the jury:

  • The trial court must inform the parties of its proposed instructions before it instructs the jury and the parties give their closing arguments.
  • The trial court must give the parties an opportunity to object on the record and outside the presence of the jury before the instructions and closing arguments are delivered to the jury.
  • The trial court may instruct the jury at any time before the jury is discharged—ie, released from its duties in the case.

Here, the trial court informed the parties of its proposed instructions and gave them an opportunity to object before it instructed the jury and before closing arguments. And since the trial court has discretion to instruct the jury at any time prior to discharge, it properly instructed the jury before closing arguments (Choice C). Therefore, the trial court did not abuse its discretion and the appellate court is unlikely to find that the trial court erred.

(Choice B) A trial court may, but is not required to, instruct the jury prior to the parties' closing arguments.

(Choice D) The parties generally must submit their proposed jury instructions before the close of evidence. However, the trial court need not instruct the jury before this time.

📌 Educational Objective

In a jury trial, a court (1) must inform the parties of its proposed instructions before instructing the jury and closing arguments, (2) must allow the parties to object on the record and outside the jury's presence before the instructions and closing arguments are delivered, and (3) may instruct the jury at any time before it is discharged.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 51(b) (court requirements for providing jury instructions).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Jury Instructions
✅ 正确答案：Choice A 上诉法院不太可能认定审判法官存在错误，因为法官有权在结案陈词（Closing Arguments）之前指导陪审团。
⚖️ 法律依据 (Legal Rule)

本题考查的核心规则是 Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 51。

根据 FRCP 51(b)(3)，法院可以在以下时间指导陪审团 (Instruct the Jury)：

  • 在结案陈词之前；
  • 在结案陈词之后；或者
  • 在陪审团解散 (Discharged) 前的任何时间。
🔍 案情分析 (Analysis)

在本案中，原告上诉的唯一理由是法官指导陪审团的时间点（即在结案陈词之前）。

虽然传统的做法通常是在结案陈词之后进行指导，但联邦民事诉讼规则赋予了法官广泛的自由裁量权 (Discretion)。

只要法官满足了以下程序性要求（本案中均已满足），其行为就是合法的：

  1. 在指导陪审团和结案陈词之前，告知双方当事人拟定的指令内容；
  2. 给予当事人在陪审团不在场时提出异议 (Object) 的机会。

因此，法官选择在结案陈词之前指导陪审团并不构成法律错误 (Error)。

❌ 干扰项排除
选项 B 错误 "Must instruct before..."
法官可以在结案陈词前指导，但并非必须。规则允许灵活性。
选项 C 错误 "Must instruct after..."
这是许多考生的误区。虽然这是常见做法，但 FRCP 51 明确允许在结案陈词前进行指导，以便陪审团在听取辩论时能更好地理解法律框架。
选项 D 错误 "Before close of evidence..."
这是当事人提交 (Submit) 建议指令的时间，而不是法官宣读 (Deliver) 指令的时间。
💡MBE 考试技巧

在涉及法院程序时间点的问题中，注意区分 "Must" (必须) 和 "May" (可以)。

对于陪审团指令 (Jury Instructions)，记住关键词：Discretion (自由裁量权)。只要是在陪审团解散前的任何时间，法官通常都有权决定何时进行指导，前提是保障了当事人的知情权和异议权。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A plaintiff brought a class action in federal court against a nationwide grocery-store chain for violating a federal disability-rights statute that requires public buildings to be wheelchair-accessible. The plaintiff sought an injunction requiring the grocery chain to modify the entrances to its stores to comply with the statute. The plaintiff demanded a jury trial.
The statute is silent on the right to a jury trial. The grocery chain does not want a jury trial.
What is the grocery chain's strongest argument that the plaintiff is not entitled to a jury trial?

choices.A: Class actions are so complex as to be outside the jury's competence to decide.
choices.B: Disability-rights claims did not exist at common law when the Seventh Amendment was adopted.
choices.C: The remedy the plaintiff seeks is primarily equitable in nature.
choices.D: The statute is silent on the right to a jury trial.

questions.explanation:
Right to jury trial in civil case
Right • Legal claim – seeks monetary remedy to compensate for loss (eg, tort/contract damages)
AND
• > $20 in controversy
No right • Equitable claim – seeks nonmonetary remedy (eg, injunction, specific performance) since legal remedy is inadequate
OR
• ≤ $20 in controversy

The Seventh Amendment guarantees the right to a jury trial in federal civil cases where the amount in controversy exceeds 20 dollars.* This right applies only to legal claims—ie, claims that seek a monetary remedy to compensate for loss (eg, damages). It does not apply to equitable claims—ie, claims that seek a nonmonetary remedy (eg, injunction). Therefore, the grocery-store chain's strongest argument that the plaintiff is not entitled to a jury trial is that the injunction the plaintiff seeks is primarily equitable in nature.

*The Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial does not apply to state civil cases because this right has never been incorporated against the states through the Fourteenth Amendment due process clause.

(Choice A) A jury is considered competent to decide class actions and other complex cases. As a result, the right to a jury trial cannot be defeated simply because the case is complex.

(Choice B) The right to a jury trial depends on the type of relief sought, not whether the asserted claim existed at common law when the Seventh Amendment was adopted.

(Choice D) The Seventh Amendment preserves the right to a jury trial in statutory actions that provide for claims analogous to claims tried at common law in which legal/monetary relief is sought. This is true even if the statute is silent on the right to a jury trial.

📌 Educational Objective

The Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial applies to federal civil cases when the amount in controversy exceeds 20 dollars and a party asserts a legal claim (ie, a claim seeking a monetary remedy). However, this right does not apply when a party asserts an equitable claim (ie, a claim seeking a nonmonetary remedy).

📚 References
  • U.S. Const. amend. VII (right to a jury trial).
  • Feltner v. Columbia Pictures Television, Inc., 523 U.S. 340, 347–48 (1998) (explaining that the Seventh Amendment right to a jury trial only applies in legal, not equitable, actions).

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Jury Trials

核心考点：第七修正案 (Seventh Amendment) 美国宪法第七修正案保留了在联邦法院进行普通法诉讼 (Suits at common law) 时享有陪审团审判的权利，前提是争议金额超过20美元。
法律 vs. 衡平法 (Law vs. Equity)

MBE 考试中判断是否有权进行陪审团审判（Jury Trial）的关键，在于区分诉讼请求的性质是属于法律 (Legal) 还是衡平法 (Equitable)。

虽然现代联邦民事诉讼规则合并了法律和衡平法，但在决定陪审团权利时，我们必须看救济措施 (Remedy) 的性质：

法律救济
(Legal Remedy)		 衡平法救济
(Equitable Remedy)
主要形式：
金钱损害赔偿
(Money Damages)		 主要形式：
禁令 (Injunction)
特定履行 (Specific Performance)
宣告性判决 (Declaratory Judgment)*
✔ 有陪审团权 ✘ 无陪审团权

*注：宣告性判决取决于其背后的基础诉讼性质。

本题解析：为何选 C？

在本案中，原告寻求的是一项禁令 (Injunction)，要求超市修改入口以符合法规。

  • 分析逻辑： 禁令是一种典型的衡平法救济 (Equitable Remedy)。
  • 结论： 第七修正案不适用于衡平法案件。因此，被告（超市）最有力的抗辩理由就是原告寻求的救济本质上是衡平法性质的。
为何其他选项是错误的？

A. 案件复杂性 (Complexity)：
错误。最高法院从未认定案件过于复杂可以作为剥夺陪审团审判权的理由。

B. 历史存在性 (Historical Existence)：
错误。第七修正案不仅适用于1791年存在的具体诉因，也适用于现代法案创造的、与1791年普通法诉讼相类似 (Analogous) 的权利。关键在于救济方式，而不是该具体权利在历史上是否存在。

D. 法案沉默 (Statutory Silence)：
错误。即使法案未明确规定陪审团权利，只要该诉讼性质上类似于普通法诉讼（即寻求金钱赔偿），宪法第七修正案依然会自动保障陪审团权利。

💡 MBE 实战技巧：Follow the Remedy
在遇到 Jury Trial 的题目时，直接看原告想要什么：
👉 想要钱 (Money Damages) = 通常有陪审团。
👉 想要对方做某事/不做某事 (Injunction/Specific Performance) = 通常无陪审团。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A 50-year-old man was set to marry a 25-year-old woman when the woman called off the wedding two days before it was set to take place. The man had spent over $200,000 on the lavish ceremony, reception, and honeymoon. He sued the woman in federal court to recover half of this amount.
During voir dire, the man's attorney attempted to use all three of his peremptory challenges to exclude three potential jurors who were 25 years old. The woman's attorney objected. The man's attorney explained that he was striking the three potential jurors based on their age.
If the court believes the attorney's justification for the peremptory challenges, will it strike those potential jurors?

choices.A: No, because civil litigants are entitled to only one peremptory challenge.
choices.B: No, because the age of the potential jurors does not reveal any bias or lack of impartiality.
choices.C: Yes, because peremptory challenges can be used for any reason.
choices.D: Yes, because peremptory challenges can be used to strike potential jurors based on their age.

questions.explanation:
Challenges to potential jurors
(FRCP 47)
Number allowed Basis for disqualification
Peremptory 3 per party*
• Any basis other than race, ethnicity, or gender
• No explanation needed
For cause Unlimited
• For bias or lack of impartiality—eg:
◦ relationship with party
◦ financial stake in party
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.
*When a civil action involves multiple plaintiffs or defendants, the court may grant each side (1) three peremptory challenges or (2) more than three peremptory challenges that each side's parties exercise separately or jointly.

Voir dire is the stage in a jury trial when the court, parties, or attorneys question potential jurors about their backgrounds and potential biases. During this process, each party may strike potential jurors from serving on the jury through:

• three peremptory challenges, which can be used to strike a potential juror for any reason (other than race, ethnicity, or gender) without explanation (Choices A & C) and

• unlimited challenges for cause, which can be used to strike a potential juror for bias or lack of impartiality (Choice B).

Here, the man's attorney attempted to use all of his peremptory challenges to exclude three potential jurors. He explained that he was striking the jurors based on their age. If the court believes this justification—ie, there is no indication that the challenges are based on race, ethnicity, or gender—then the court will strike the three potential jurors.

📌 Educational Objective

During jury selection, each party is entitled to (1) three peremptory challenges to strike a potential juror for any reason (other than race, ethnicity, gender) without an explanation and (2) an unlimited number of challenges for cause to strike a potential juror for bias or lack of impartiality.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 47(b) (peremptory challenges).
  • 28 U.S.C. § 1870 (jury challenges).
  • J.E.B. v. Alabama, 511 U.S. 127, 143 (1994) (explaining that peremptory challenges may be used to remove potential jurors based on their age).

一名50岁男子原定与一名25岁女子结婚，但在婚礼预定举行的两天前，该女子取消了婚礼。该男子已为这场奢华的典礼、招待会和蜜月花费了超过20万美元。他在联邦法院起诉该女子，要求追回这笔金额的一半。

在陪审团预选（voir dire）期间，男方的律师试图使用其全部三次无因回避权，来排除三名年龄为25岁的潜在陪审员。女方的律师对此提出反对。男方的律师解释称，他是基于年龄的原因排除这三名潜在陪审员。

如果法庭相信律师就其无因回避权所提出的理由，法庭会排除这些潜在陪审员吗？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为民事诉讼当事人仅有权行使一次无因回避。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为潜在陪审员的年龄并未显示出任何偏见或缺乏公正性。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为无因回避可以基于任何理由使用。
zh-choices.D: 会，因为无因回避可以用来基于年龄排除潜在陪审员。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

联邦民事诉讼程序 (Civil Procedure)
正确答案：D
是的，因为无因回避 (Peremptory Challenges) 可以用来基于年龄排除潜在陪审员。
⚖️ 核心法律规则

本题考察的是陪审团遴选 (Jury Selection) 阶段中，律师行使无因回避权 (Peremptory Challenges) 的限制范围。

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP 47) 和相关判例法，律师在排除潜在陪审员时有两种方式：

类型 规则详解
有因回避
Challenge for Cause
  • 数量：无限制 (Unlimited)。
  • 理由：必须证明陪审员存在偏见 (Bias) 或缺乏公正性（例如与当事人有亲属关系或经济利益）。
无因回避
Peremptory Challenge
  • 数量：联邦民事案件中，每方通常有 3次。
  • 理由：通常不需要解释理由，但是受到宪法限制。
🚫 宪法限制 (Batson Rule)

虽然名为“无因”回避，但最高法院在 Batson v. Kentucky 及其后续判例中确立了严格的限制：

律师不得基于以下特征排除陪审员：

  • ❌ 种族 (Race)
  • ❌ 族裔 (Ethnicity)
  • ❌ 性别 (Gender) (J.E.B. v. Alabama)

关键点：最高法院从未将“年龄”列为受保护的类别。因此，基于年龄 (Age) 行使无因回避是合宪的。

🔍 案情分析

在本案中，男方律师明确表示他是因为“年龄”（25岁）而排除这三名陪审员。虽然这看起来有歧视嫌疑，但在法律上，年龄歧视并不适用于陪审团遴选的宪法审查。只要不是基于种族或性别，律师可以使用无因回避权排除特定年龄段的人（例如认为年轻人可能更同情毁约的年轻未婚妻）。

❌ 为什么其他选项错误？

选项 A 错误： 联邦法律 (28 U.S.C. § 1870) 规定民事诉讼当事人有权行使 3次 无因回避，而不是1次。

选项 B 错误： 混淆了“有因回避”和“无因回避”。只有“有因回避”才需要证明偏见。无因回避不需要证明偏见，只要不违反宪法（种族/性别）即可。

选项 C 错误（陷阱选项）： 虽然通常说无因回避可以用作“任何理由”，但这个表述在法律上是不严谨的，因为它不能用于种族或性别。选项 D 比 选项 C 更准确，因为它具体针对了题目中的事实（年龄），且在法律上完全成立。

💡 MBE 考试技巧 遇到关于 Peremptory Challenges 的题目时，请遵循以下思维导图：
  1. 这是基于种族或性别吗？
    👉 是 ➔ 违宪 (Batson violation)。
  2. 这是基于其他原因（如年龄、职业、发型、态度）吗？
    👉 是 ➔ 合法，允许排除。

questions.question:
A football team entered into a 10-year lease with a city for use of the city's athletic stadium. Five years into the lease, the team threatened to leave the stadium and move to another city.
The city sued the team in federal court, seeking a permanent injunction to prevent the team from breaching its lease and leaving. In its answer, the team included a counterclaim seeking $10 million in damages for losses caused by the city's alleged failure to properly maintain the stadium, as the lease required. The team demanded a jury trial on the counterclaim.
The city moved to try its claim for a permanent injunction before the trial on the team's counterclaim. The team objected and moved that the jury trial of its counterclaim be held before the trial of the city's injunction claim.
How should the court rule on the parties' motions?

choices.A: The court should first hold a jury trial of the team's counterclaim, and then a nonjury trial of the issues remaining in the city's claim.
choices.B: The court should first hold a nonjury trial of the city's claim, and then a jury trial of the issues remaining in the team's counterclaim.
choices.C: The court should first hold a nonjury trial of the city's claim without giving binding effect to its findings or conclusions in the later jury trial of the team's counterclaim.
choices.D: The court should schedule a jury trial of both the city's claim and the team's counterclaim.

questions.explanation:
Right to jury trial in civil case
Right
  • Legal claim – seeks monetary remedy to compensate for loss (eg, tort/contract damages)
AND
  • > $20 in controversy
No right
  • Equitable claim – seeks nonmonetary remedy (eg, injunction, specific performance) since legal remedy is inadequate
OR
  • ≤ $20 in controversy

The Seventh Amendment guarantees the right to a jury trial in civil cases where the amount in controversy exceeds 20 dollars. But this right only applies to legal claims (eg, the team's $10 million counterclaim)—not equitable claims (eg, the city's permanent injunction claim). And when, as here, a case involves both legal and equitable claims that share common issues of fact (eg, obligations under the stadium lease), the court must first hold a jury trial on the legal claim (Choice B). The judge must then hold a nonjury trial on the equitable claim, relying on the jury's findings of fact on the legal claim to do so (Choices C & D).

📌 Educational Objective

When a case involves legal and equitable claims that share common fact issues, the court should hold a jury trial on the legal claim before holding a nonjury trial on the equitable claim.

📚 References
  • U.S. Const. amend. VII (right to a jury trial).
  • Beacon Theatres v. Westover, 359 U.S. 500, 510–11 (1959) (stating that legal claims must be decided by a jury before the court determines related equitable claims).

一支橄榄球队与一个城市签订了一份为期10年的租约，以使用该市的体育场。租约生效五年后，该球队威胁要离开体育场并迁往另一个城市。

该市向联邦法院起诉该球队，寻求永久性禁令，以防止该球队违反租约并离开。在其答辩中，该球队提出了一项反诉，要求赔偿1000万美元，以弥补因该市未能按租约要求妥善维护体育场而造成的损失。该球队要求对其反诉进行陪审团审判。

该市动议，要求在审理球队的反诉之前，先审理其永久性禁令的诉求。该球队表示反对，并动议要求在审理市府的禁令诉求之前，先对其反诉进行陪审团审判。

法院应如何对双方的动议作出裁决？

zh-choices.A: 法院应首先对球队的反诉进行陪审团审判，然后对市府诉求中的其余问题进行法官审判。
zh-choices.B: 法院应首先对市府的诉求进行法官审判，然后对球队反诉中的其余问题进行陪审团审判。
zh-choices.C: 法院应首先对市府的诉求进行法官审判，但其裁决或结论在之后对球队反诉的陪审团审判中不具有约束力。
zh-choices.D: 法院应安排对市府的诉求和球队的反诉同时进行陪审团审判。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure (民事诉讼法)

核心考点：审判顺序

当一个案件同时包含法律诉求 (Legal Claims) 和衡平诉求 (Equitable Claims)，且两者涉及共同的事实问题时，法院应如何安排审判顺序？

Legal Claim
(法律诉求)
金钱赔偿 (Damages)
有陪审团权利
Equitable Claim
(衡平诉求)
禁令 (Injunction)
无法律赔偿时适用
无陪审团权利
⚖️ 黄金法则 (The Beacon Theatres Rule)

根据美国宪法第七修正案 (Seventh Amendment) 和最高法院判例 Beacon Theatres v. Westover (1959)：

如果案件涉及共同事实问题 (Common Issues of Fact)：

  1. 必须首先由陪审团审理法律诉求。
  2. 法官随后审理衡平诉求，且法官必须受陪审团对共同事实认定的约束。
1. 识别诉求性质
  • 市府的诉求：永久性禁令 (Permanent Injunction) → 衡平诉求 (Equitable)。
  • 球队的反诉：1000万美元赔偿 (Damages) → 法律诉求 (Legal)。
2. 识别共同事实

双方的争议核心都是“租约是否被违背”以及“体育场维护状况”。这是共同事实问题 (Common Issues of Fact)。

3. 应用规则

为了保护球队在法律诉求（反诉）上的陪审团审判权 (Right to Jury Trial)，陪审团必须先对事实做出裁决。

如果法官先审理禁令并认定“市府没有违约”，这将构成既判力 (Issue Preclusion)，导致陪审团在后续审理反诉时无法重新认定该事实，从而剥夺了球队的宪法权利。

选项 A 正确 先陪审团审反诉，后法官审禁令。
这是唯一符合第七修正案要求的程序。陪审团先解决事实争议，法官再基于这些事实决定是否颁布禁令。
选项 B 错误 先法官审，后陪审团审。
这违反了 Beacon Theatres 原则。法官的先行裁决会通过“附带禁反言” (Collateral Estoppel) 束缚陪审团，实质上剥夺了陪审团审判权。
选项 C 错误 先法官审，但不具约束力。
这会导致司法资源的浪费和判决的不一致性。联邦法院不采用这种做法。
选项 D 错误 全部由陪审团审判。
陪审团通常只负责法律诉求（金钱赔偿）。禁令（Injunction）属于衡平法救济，传统上由法官决定，陪审团无权直接裁决禁令的颁布（尽管其实施需基于陪审团认定的事实）。
MBE 解题技巧：
看到 "Damages" + "Injunction" 同时出现，
口诀：Jury First (陪审团优先)。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A farm employee sued four pesticide companies in a federal district court. The employee claimed that his exposure to the pesticide manufactured by one of these companies caused him to suffer a terminal illness.
The companies filed a joint motion to dismiss the claim on the ground that the employee did not allege which company manufactured the pesticide to which he was exposed. The court denied the companies' motion, concluding that the employee did not need to specifically allege which company manufactured the pesticide because market-share liability applied. The court also informed the parties that all requests for jury instructions must be filed by the start of trial. Neither side filed a request by the deadline.
At the close of evidence, the companies filed a request that the court use the companies' jury instructions on market-share liability. The court denied the companies' request on the ground that the companies filed their request too late.
Did the court properly deny the companies' request?

choices.A: No, because although the companies did not submit their request by the deadline, they could not have reasonably anticipated that market-share liability would be an issue.
choices.B: No, because the companies submitted their request at the close of evidence.
choices.C: Yes, because only the court may formulate jury instructions.
choices.D: Yes, because the companies did not submit their request by the deadline and should have reasonably anticipated that market-share liability would be an issue.

questions.explanation:
Jury instructions
(FRCP 51)
Requests
Party:
  • must file request by close of evidence unless earlier, reasonable deadline set by court
  • may file request after close of evidence when:
  • request relates to issue that party could not have reasonably anticipated by deadline or
  • court permits late submission related to any issue
Instructions
Court:
  • must inform parties of proposed instructions before instructing jury & closing arguments
  • must allow parties to object on record & outside jury's presence before instructing jury & closing arguments
  • may consider objection made after court instructs jury if instruction constituted plain error
  • may instruct jury at any time before discharge
Objections
Party:
  • must distinctly state objection & its grounds on record
  • must object at court-appointed time or promptly after learning of proposed instruction
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.

A court must provide jury instructions that advise the jurors on their deliberation procedures and the applicable law. These instructions can be formulated by the court or the parties (Choice C). Each party can request specific jury instructions before or at the close of evidence unless the court sets an earlier, reasonable deadline—eg, by the start of trial (as seen here) (Choice B).* Additionally, a request may be filed after the close of evidence if:

  • the request relates to an issue that the party could not have reasonably anticipated by the deadline or
  • the court permits a late submission that relates to any issue.

Here, the companies filed no jury instructions by the deadline set by the court. And the companies should have reasonably anticipated that market-share liability would be an issue. That is because the court concluded that market-share liability applied to this case when it denied the companies' motion to dismiss (Choice A). Therefore, the court properly denied the companies' jury-instruction request on market-share liability.

*To request a jury instruction, a party generally must file a written request with the court and furnish it to every other party.
Some courts allow verbal requests, but they are highly disfavored.

📌 Educational Objective

A party must request specific jury instructions at the close of evidence unless an earlier, reasonable deadline is set by the court. A request can be filed after the close of evidence only when (1) the instruction relates to an issue that could not have been reasonably anticipated by the deadline or (2) the court grants permission.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 51(a) (jury-instruction requests).
questions.zh-question:
一名农场雇员在联邦地区法院起诉了四家杀虫剂公司。该雇员声称，他因接触其中一家公司生产的杀虫剂而患上了绝症。

这些公司联合提出驳回起诉的动议，理由是该雇员未能指明他所接触的杀虫剂是由哪家公司生产的。法院驳回了这些公司的动议，裁定该雇员无需具体指明是哪家公司生产了该杀虫剂，因为本案适用市场份额责任（market-share liability）原则。法院还通知各方当事人，所有关于陪审团指令的请求必须在审判开始前提交。双方均未在截止日期前提交请求。

在证据调查结束时，这些公司提交了一项请求，要求法院采用其关于市场份额责任的陪审团指令。法院驳回了这些公司的请求，理由是他们提交请求的时间过晚。

法院驳回这些公司的请求是否得当？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为尽管这些公司未在截止日期前提交请求，但他们无法合理预见市场份额责任会成为一个争议点。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为这些公司在证据调查结束时提交了请求。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为只有法院可以制订陪审团指令。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为这些公司未在截止日期前提交请求，并且本应合理预见到市场份额责任会成为一个争议点。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Jury Instructions
正确答案：选项 D
法院驳回请求是恰当的，因为公司错过了截止日期且该问题是可预见的。
⚖️ 核心法律规则 (FRCP 51)

联邦民事诉讼规则第 51 条 (FRCP 51) 规定了提交陪审团指令 (Jury Instructions) 的时间要求：

  1. 一般规则： 当事人必须在证据调查结束 (Close of evidence) 时提交请求。
  2. 法院命令： 法院可以设定一个更早的合理截止日期（例如审判开始前）。
  3. 逾期提交的例外： 如果错过了截止日期，只有在以下情况才允许补交：
    • 该请求涉及的问题在截止日期前无法合理预见 (Could not reasonably have been anticipated)；或者
    • 法院允许迟交。
🔍 案情逻辑分析
1
法院设定了截止日期：
法院明确通知各方，陪审团指令必须在“审判开始前”提交。这符合 FRCP 51 允许法院设定更早截止日期的规定。
2
公司违规：
双方均未在审判开始前提交请求，而是在“证据调查结束”时才提交。这已经晚于法院设定的截止日期。
3
关键测试——可预见性：
公司能否主张“市场份额责任” (Market-share liability) 是不可预见的新问题？
不能。因为在审判前，法院在驳回公司的“驳回起诉动议” (Motion to Dismiss) 时，已经明确裁定本案适用市场份额责任。因此，公司完全应当预见到这是一个需要陪审团指令的关键法律问题。
❌ 为什么其他选项错误？
选项 A 错误：
声称公司“无法合理预见”该问题是错误的。法院在审前裁决中已经明确提到了市场份额责任，因此这是完全可预见的。
选项 B 错误：
虽然 FRCP 51 的默认规则是在“证据调查结束”时提交，但规则允许法院设定“更早的截止日期”。本案中法院已设定了更早的期限，当事人必须遵守。
选项 C 错误：
虽然法院最终决定给陪审团什么指令，但当事人有权也有责任请求 (Request) 特定的指令。说“只有法院可以制订”是不准确的，且与本案关于“请求时限”的争议点无关。
💡 MBE 考试技巧
遇到关于 Jury Instructions 的题目，请按以下顺序检查：
  1. 法院是否设定了特定截止日期？（如有，优先于默认规则）
  2. 如果当事人迟交了，是否存在“无法合理预见”的新问题？
  3. 如果问题是老生常谈（如本案中的核心责任理论），迟交通常会被驳回。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
An employee brought a federal diversity action against her former employer for negligence. Before the close of evidence, the parties submitted proposed jury instructions. Prior to the parties' closing arguments, the judge informed the parties of the instructions she would give, provided them an opportunity to object, and instructed the jury.
During the employer's closing argument, the employee repeatedly yelled out, "That's a lie!" After several warnings, the judge ordered the bailiff to remove the employee from the courtroom. At the conclusion of the employer's closing argument, the employer has requested that the judge instruct the jury to disregard the employee's outbursts.
What argument has the best chance of persuading the court to give this jury instruction?

choices.A: The employee's conduct was plain error that affected the employer's substantial rights.
choices.B: The employer could not have reasonably anticipated this issue by the close of evidence.
choices.C: The judge did not set a deadline for jury-instruction requests.
choices.D: The parties may request jury instructions at any time before the jury is discharged.

questions.explanation:
Jury instructions
(FRCP 51)
Requests
Party:
  • must file request by close of evidence unless earlier, reasonable deadline set by court
  • may file request after close of evidence when:
    • request relates to issue that party could not have reasonably anticipated by deadline or
    • court permits late submission related to any issue
Instructions
Court:
  • must inform parties of proposed instructions before instructing jury & closing arguments
  • must allow parties to object on record & outside jury's presence before instructing jury & closing arguments
  • may consider objection made after court instructs jury if instruction constituted plain error
  • may instruct jury at any time before discharge
Objections
Party:
  • must distinctly state objection & its grounds on record
  • must object at court-appointed time or promptly after learning of proposed instruction
FRCP = Federal Rule of Civil Procedure.
Jury instructions advise jurors on their deliberation procedures and the applicable law. These instructions can be formulated by the court or the parties. FRCP 51 allows each party to request specific jury instructions before or at the close of evidence unless the court sets an earlier, reasonable deadline.*

Additionally, a request may be filed after the close of evidence if:
  • the request relates to an issue that the party could not have reasonably anticipated by the deadline or
  • the court permits a late submission that relates to any issue.

Here, the employer requested after the close of evidence that the judge instruct the jury to disregard the employee's outbursts during the employer's closing argument. As a result, the employer's best argument to persuade the court to give this instruction is that the employer could not have reasonably anticipated this issue by the close of evidence.

*To request a jury instruction, a party generally must file a written request with the court and furnish it to every other party.
Some courts allow verbal requests, but they are highly disfavored.

(Choice A) When a party fails to preserve an error by objecting at trial, the error can only be reviewed via posttrial relief or appeal if it is a plain error. However, the employer is not seeking posttrial relief or an appeal, so this is not the best argument.

(Choice C) When a trial judge does not set a deadline for jury-instruction requests, the default deadline is the close of evidence. Since that deadline has already passed, this argument is unlikely to persuade the court.

(Choice D) The court may instruct the jury at any time before the jury is discharged—ie, released from its duties in the case. However, the parties must file their requests for jury instructions before or at the close of evidence unless an exception applies (as seen here).

📌 Educational Objective

A party may request specific jury instructions after the close of evidence when (1) the instruction relates to an issue that could not have been reasonably anticipated by the deadline or (2) the court grants permission.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 51(a) (jury-instruction requests).
questions.zh-question:
一名前雇员因疏忽向其前雇主提起了联邦多元管辖权诉讼。在证据调查结束前，双方当事人提交了拟议的陪审团指令。在双方当事人进行最后陈述之前，法官告知了双方她将要给出的指令，给予了他们提出异议的机会，并对陪审团进行了指示。

在雇主的最后陈述期间，该雇员反复大喊：“那是谎言！” 经过几次警告后，法官命令法警将该雇员带离法庭。在雇主的最后陈述结束时，雇主请求法官指示陪审团忽略该雇员的情绪爆发行为。

哪一项论点最有可能说服法院给出这项陪审团指令？

zh-choices.A: 该雇员的行为是明显错误，影响了雇主的重大利益。
zh-choices.B: 在证据调查结束前，雇主无法合理预见到此问题。
zh-choices.C: 法官没有为请求陪审团指令设定截止日期。
zh-choices.D: 在陪审团解散前的任何时候，双方当事人都可以请求陪审团指令。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

联邦民事诉讼规则 (FRCP) 第 51 条
⚖️ 法律规则：陪审团指令的请求时间 根据 FRCP 51(a)，当事人通常必须在证据调查结束 (Close of Evidence) 之前或之时提交陪审团指令请求。

例外情况： 如果请求涉及的问题是当事人在截止日期前无法合理预见 (Could not reasonably have anticipated) 的，当事人可以在证据调查结束后提交请求。

📅 案情时间线分析

证据调查结束 (Close of Evidence)
通常的指令请求截止点。
法官指示陪审团 (Jury Instructions)
最后陈述 (Closing Arguments)
⚡ 突发事件：雇员大喊 "That's a lie!"
雇主请求新指令
请求法官让陪审团忽略该喊叫。

本案的关键在于：导致需要新指令的事件（雇员大喊大叫）发生在证据调查结束之后。雇主在证据截止前不可能预见到雇员会在最后陈述时大闹法庭。

正确答案：选项 B

理由：这是 FRCP 51(a)(2)(A) 规定的直接应用。

要说服法官接受这个迟交的指令请求 (Late Request)，最有力的论点是证明该请求符合“无法合理预见”的例外情况。既然干扰行为发生在最后陈述阶段，雇主在之前的截止日期（证据结束时）显然无法预知此事。

❌ 为什么其他选项是错的？

选项 A：明显错误 (Plain Error)

解析：“明显错误”标准通常用于上诉 (Appeal) 阶段，用来审查那些在审判中未被及时反对的错误。本案目前仍处于审判 (Trial) 阶段，雇主正在向初审法官提出请求，而不是在上诉，因此这不是最佳论据。

选项 C：法官未设截止日期

解析：如果法官没有设定具体的截止日期，FRCP 51 规定的默认截止日期就是证据调查结束时。既然该时间点已过，强调“未设截止日期”并不能帮助雇主，因为默认期限已经过期了。

选项 D：任何时候都可以请求

解析：这是对规则的误解。虽然法院 (The Court) 可以在陪审团解散前的任何时间给出指令，但当事人 (The Parties) 必须遵守提交请求的截止日期（除非符合例外情况）。当事人并没有“随时请求”的权利。

💡 MBE 解题技巧：
在处理程序性问题（如 FRCP）时，密切关注时间节点 (Timing)。
如果题目问的是“迟交的申请”为何有效，答案通常与“正当理由 (Good Cause)”或“无法预见 (Unforeseeability)”有关，而不是一般性的权利主张。

questions.question:
A company from State A filed a federal diversity action against its distributor, seeking $750,000 in damages. The company demanded a jury trial, and 10 jurors were selected to hear the case.
After closing arguments, the judge instructed the jury. The jury deliberated for three days until the foreman sent a note to the judge informing her that the jury could not reach a decision. The judge brought the jury back into the courtroom and instructed the jurors on their duty to carefully and deliberately consider the evidence to reach a decision.
The jury returned a verdict the next day in which nine jurors found in favor of the company for the full amount sought. The judge agreed with the jury and entered a final judgment in accordance with the verdict. The distributor has timely filed a motion for a new trial.
Should the court grant the distributor's motion?

choices.A: No, because a super-majority of jurors agreed on the verdict.
choices.B: No, because the judge agrees with the jury's verdict.
choices.C: Yes, because the verdict was not unanimous.
choices.D: Yes, because there were fewer than 12 jurors.

questions.explanation:
Jury pool summoned
6-12 jurors impaneled
Unanimous verdict returned

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 48, a jury must consist of at least 6 and no more than 12 members (Choice D). Unless otherwise stipulated, the jury must reach a unanimous verdict—i.e., a formal decision on factual issues that is rendered at the conclusion of trial.* Here, only 9 out of the 10 jurors returned a verdict in favor of the company. Since there is no indication that the parties stipulated to a non-unanimous verdict, the court should grant the distributor's motion for new trial (Choice A).

*In reaching a verdict, jurors must listen to the evidence presented in court and weigh it fairly. They should not consider matters not formally admitted into evidence or discuss the facts of the case with nonjurors.

(Choice B) Whether the judge agrees with the jury's verdict is irrelevant since it was not unanimous.

📌 Educational Objective

A jury verdict must be unanimous and returned by a jury of at least 6 (but no more than 12) members unless the parties stipulate otherwise.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 48 (number of jurors and unanimous-verdict requirements).

来自A州的一家公司对其经销商提起了一项联邦多元管辖权诉讼，寻求75万美元的损害赔偿。该公司要求进行陪审团审判，并选定了10名陪审员审理此案。

在结案陈词后，法官对陪审团作出了指示。陪审团评议了三天，直到陪审长给法官递交了一张便条，告知她陪审团无法达成裁决。法官将陪审团带回法庭，并指示陪审员履行其职责，即仔细审慎地考量证据以达成裁决。

第二天，陪审团作出了一项裁决，其中九名陪审员裁定公司胜诉，并判予其所要求的全部金额。法官同意陪审团的裁决，并根据该裁决录入了最终判决。该经销商已及时提交了一项要求重新审判的动议。

法院是否应批准该经销商的动议？

zh-choices.A: 不应批准，因为绝大多数陪审员就该裁决达成了一致。
zh-choices.B: 不应批准，因为法官同意陪审团的裁决。
zh-choices.C: 应批准，因为该裁决并非全体一致。
zh-choices.D: 应批准，因为陪审员人数少于12人。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Jury Verdicts

正确答案：C

本题考查的是联邦民事诉讼中关于陪审团裁决一致性 (Unanimity) 的规则。

核心法律规则 (The Rule)
Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 48 (FRCP 48)

在联邦民事审判中：
  1. 人数：陪审团必须由至少 6 名且不超过 12 名成员组成。
  2. 一致性：除非当事人另有约定 (Stipulate otherwise)，否则裁决必须是全体一致的 (Unanimous)。
案情分析 (Analysis)
1
适用法律：本案是联邦多元管辖权案件 (Federal Diversity Action)，根据 Erie 原则，程序法适用联邦规则 (FRCP)。
2
事实认定：陪审团由 10 人组成。最终裁决时，只有 9 人赞成公司胜诉 (9 jurors found in favor)。
3
关键缺失：题目中明确指出 "there is no indication that the parties stipulated to a non-unanimous verdict"（无迹象表明双方约定了非一致裁决）。
4
结论：由于缺乏全体一致性且无例外约定，该裁决在联邦法院无效。法院应当批准重新审判 (New Trial) 的动议。
选项辨析
选项 A 错误：虽然某些州法院允许“绝对多数” (Super-majority) 裁决，但在联邦民事法庭，默认规则必须是全体一致。
选项 B 错误：法官是否同意陪审团的结论与裁决的程序合法性无关。陪审团是事实认定者 (Fact-finder)，其裁决必须符合程序要求（即一致性）。
选项 D 错误：FRCP 48 允许陪审团人数在 6 到 12 人之间。本案有 10 名陪审员，符合人数要求。错误在于“意见不一致”，而不是“人数不足”。
🎓 MBE 考试技巧：
1. 区分联邦与州：看到 "Federal Action" 时，必须应用 FRCP。很多考生会混淆州法院（通常允许非一致裁决）和联邦法院的规则。
2. 寻找“约定” (Stipulation)：FRCP 48 是可以被当事人豁免的。如果题目说 "Parties agreed to accept a verdict of 9 jurors"，那么答案就会完全相反。
3. 人数陷阱：记住联邦民事陪审团下限是 6 人。如果审判期间有陪审员生病退出，只要剩下至少 6 人且全体一致，裁决依然有效。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A plaintiff brought a diversity action against a defendant in federal court in State A. At a pretrial conference, the attorneys stipulated to a jury of 14 jurors and 4 alternates and submitted this request to the judge. State courts in State A allow 14-person juries.
Is the judge likely to comply with the parties' request?

choices.A: No, because a 14-person jury is not allowed in federal court.
choices.B: No, because there must be half as many alternate jurors as selected jurors.
choices.C: Yes, because state courts in State A allow 14-person juries.
choices.D: Yes, because the parties stipulated to a 14-person jury.

questions.explanation:
Jury pool summoned
6-12 jurors impaneled
Unanimous verdict returned

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 48(a), a jury in federal civil cases must have at least 6 but no more than 12 members. The parties may stipulate to the size of the jury so long as the stipulation stays within the requisite range. Here, the parties asked the judge to seat 14 jurors, which exceeds the maximum amount of 12 possible jurors (Choice D). Therefore, the judge is unlikely to comply with the parties' request.

(Choice B) An alternate juror is a person who steps in when a member of the jury is excused for good cause (eg, illness, family emergency). There is no requirement for the number of alternate jurors that must be selected, but federal courts generally select two or three.

(Choice C) Although state courts in State A allow 14-person juries, federal law controls procedural issues (eg, jury size) in diversity actions. Therefore, juries in federal civil cases must have 6 to 12 members.

📌 Educational Objective

A federal civil jury trial must begin with at least 6 and no more than 12 members. The parties may stipulate to the size of the jury so long as the stipulation stays within the requisite range.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 48(a) (number of jurors).

法官是否可能准许当事方的请求？

zh-choices.A: 不会，因为联邦法院不允许14人组成的陪审团。
zh-choices.B: 不会，因为候补陪审员的人数必须是正式陪审员的一半。
zh-choices.C: 会，因为A州的州法院允许14人组成的陪审团。

MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure | Jury Trials
正确答案：A (No) 法官不会批准该请求，因为联邦法院不允许由 14 名陪审员组成的陪审团。
核心考点：FRCP 48(a)

本题考察的是《联邦民事诉讼规则》(Federal Rules of Civil Procedure, FRCP) 第 48 条关于陪审团人数的硬性规定。

规则原文要义：
联邦民事陪审团在审判开始时 (Impaneling)，必须由 至少 6 人，至多 12 人 组成。

这是一个结构性的、强制性的规则。虽然当事人可以在许多程序性事项上达成一致（Stipulate），但他们不能约定违反这一人数上限。

为什么其他理由不成立？

1. 州法无关紧要 (Erie Doctrine)

虽然这是一起基于多元管辖权 (Diversity Action) 的案件，但根据 Erie 原则，联邦法院在程序问题上适用联邦规则 (FRCP)。陪审团人数属于程序问题，因此 A 州允许 14 人陪审团的州法律在联邦法院不适用。

2. 当事人的约定 (Stipulation) 有局限性

阶段 规则 (FRCP 48) 能否约定例外？
组建时

(不可豁免)
裁决时
(Verdict)		 至少 6 人 可以
(可约定少于 6 人作出裁决)

*注：本题问的是审判开始时的组建，因此触犯了 12 人的上限。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
Before the close of evidence in a federal negligence trial, the defendant submitted a proposed jury instruction on contributory negligence. Before instructing the jury, the judge informed the parties of the instructions she would give, which did not include the defendant's proposed contributory-negligence instruction but did include the court's own instruction on contributory negligence. Neither party objected, either then or after the judge had given the instructions. The jury returned a verdict for the plaintiff, and the judge entered judgment on the verdict.
The defendant would like to appeal the verdict on the ground that the judge should have instructed the jury using the defendant's proposed instruction on contributory negligence.
Has the defendant preserved the issue for appeal?

choices.A: No, because the defendant failed to object after the judge gave the instructions to the jury.
choices.B: No, because the defendant failed to object after the judge informed the parties of the instructions she would give.
choices.C: Yes, because the defendant submitted a proposed instruction on contributory negligence.
choices.D: Yes, because the judge's failure to give the defendant's contributory-negligence instruction amounted to a ruling on the instruction.

questions.explanation:
Preserving error in jury instructions
Trial starts
→
Close of evidence
→
Judge shares proposed instructions
→
Closing arguments
→
Judge instructs jury
→
Jury deliberates & returns verdict
Filing request +
definitive ruling
=
error preserved
Objecting on record
=
error preserved
error waived

To challenge a jury instruction on appeal (ie, to preserve error), a party must raise the issue at trial. This can be done at the close of evidence (or otherwise at the court's direction) by:

  • filing a written request for the jury instruction that the party would like the court to give and
  • obtaining a definitive ruling on that request from the court on the record.

This can also be done after the court has informed the parties of its proposed instructions (but before it has instructed the jury and before final arguments) by clearly identifying the matter objected to, and the grounds for the objection, on the record.

Here, the defendant proposed a jury instruction on contributory negligence before the close of evidence. But the defendant never obtained a definitive ruling on that proposal from the court on the record (eg, "Your request is denied"). Instead, the judge merely informed the parties of the instructions she would give, which did not include the defendant's proposed instruction (Choice D). And since the defendant failed to object before the judge instructed the jury, this issue was not preserved for appeal (Choice A).

(Choice C) Submitting a proposed jury instruction only preserves the issue for appeal when the court definitively rules on that request on the record—which the court failed to do here.

📌 Educational Objective

A jury-instruction error is preserved for appeal when a party raises the issue (1) at the close of evidence by filing a written request for the proposed instruction and obtaining a definitive court ruling on the record OR (2) before the court instructs the jury by clearly identifying, and stating the grounds for the objection on the record.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 51 (preserving error regarding requests for, and objections to, jury instructions).

在一场联邦过失审判中，证据出示结束前，被告提交了一份关于与有过失的陪审团拟议指令。在指示陪审团之前，法官告知双方她将要给出的指令，其中不包括被告提议的与有过失指令，但包括了法院自己关于与有过失的指令。无论是当时还是在法官给出指令后，双方均未提出异议。陪审团作出了有利于原告的裁决，法官根据该裁决作出了判决。

被告希望以上诉，理由是法官本应使用被告提议的与有过失指令来指示陪审团。

被告是否为上诉保留了该争议点？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为在法官向陪审团给出指令后，被告未能提出异议。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为在法官告知双方她将要给出的指令后，被告未能提出异议。
zh-choices.C: 是，因为被告提交了一份关于与有过失的拟议指令。
zh-choices.D: 是，因为法官未能给出被告的与有过失指令相当于对该指令作出了裁定。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure (民事诉讼法)
正确答案：B

Defendant 未能保留上诉理由，因为在法官告知双方拟议指令后，Defendant 未提出异议。

⚖️ 法律依据：FRCP Rule 51

本题考查《联邦民事诉讼规则》第51条关于陪审团指令 (Jury Instructions) 的异议保留规则。

Rule 51(c)(1) - 异议的要求
当事人若要针对陪审团指令提出上诉（保留错误），必须在记录在案 (on the record) 的情况下提出异议，明确指出：
  1. 反对的事项；
  2. 反对的理由。
Rule 51(b)(2) - 时间点
法官必须在指示陪审团和进行最终辩论 (Final Arguments) 之前，告知双方其拟议的指令。此时是当事人提出异议的关键窗口期。
🔍 逻辑推演
1
提交并非保留： 被告虽然提交了拟议指令 (Proposed Instruction)，但这仅仅是“请求”。单纯提交请求并不等同于对法官拒绝该请求后的“异议”。
2
法官的通知： 法官告知双方她将使用自己的指令，而不包括被告的指令。此时，法官履行了 Rule 51(b)(1) 的义务。
3
沉默即放弃 (Waiver)： 当法官告知不使用被告的指令时，被告必须在此时（或在法官指示陪审团之前）提出正式异议 (Object)。
4

"No Objection, No Appeal"

A man brought a federal diversity action against his former business partner for breach of contract seeking $100,000 in damages. The business partner moved to dismiss for lack of personal jurisdiction. After the court denied the motion, the business partner filed and served an answer in which she denied the man's claim. Ten days later, the man filed and served a jury demand, which the business partner moved to strike.
Is the court likely to grant the motion to strike?

choices.A: No, because the man properly demanded a jury trial.
choices.B: No, because the right to a jury trial extends to civil claims.
choices.C: Yes, because the jury demand was untimely filed.
choices.D: Yes, because the man failed to assert the jury demand in a pleading.

All civil litigants (plaintiffs and defendants) have the constitutional right to a jury trial for any legal claim where the amount in controversy exceeds $20 (as seen here). However, a party waives this right if a proper demand is not made. Under FRCP 38, a party may properly demand a jury trial by:

  • serving the other parties with a written jury demand within 14 days after the last pleading (usually the defendant's answer) is served and
  • filing the demand with the court within a reasonable time after service of the demand.*

Here, the man filed and served his written jury demand 10 days after being served with the business partner's answer. Since the demand was timely and properly made, the court is unlikely to strike it (Choice C).

*A jury trial demand is treated as a request that a jury decide all issues unless the party specifies otherwise. If so specified, another party may serve a jury trial demand for any other issue within 14 days after service of the original demand or a shorter time ordered by the court.

(Choice B) Parties have a jury trial right for legal claims—ie, claims seeking a monetary remedy to compensate for a loss (eg, damages). But this right does not extend to equitable claims—ie, claims seeking a nonmonetary remedy (eg, injunction).

(Choice D) A jury trial demand may, but need not, be included in a pleading. The demand can also be made in a separate, stand-alone document (as seen here).

必须在针对该争议点的最后一份诉讼文书 (Last Pleading Directed to the Issue) 送达后的 14天内，向其他当事人送达书面的陪审团审判请求 (Jury Demand)。
本案分析

本题考察的是陪审团请求的及时性 (Timeliness)。

1
确定“最后一份诉讼文书”：
在本案中，被告（商业伙伴）提交的答辩状 (Answer) 否认了原告的违约指控。这通常被视为针对该事实争议点的最后一份诉讼文书。
2
计算时间窗口：
原告必须在答辩状送达后的 14 天内提出请求。
3
结论：
原告在答辩状送达后 10天 就提交并送达了请求。10天 < 14天，因此该请求是及时且恰当的。

因此，法院不会批准被告要求删除该请求的动议。正确答案是 Choice A。

为什么其他选项是错的？
❌ Choice B (权利范围太广):
虽然陪审团权利很重要，但它不是绝对的。如果当事人未能在规定时间内提出请求（Waiver），该权利就会丧失。此外，陪审团权利仅适用于法律诉求 (Legal Claims)，不适用于衡平法诉求 (Equitable Claims)。本题的关键在于程序是否合规，而非权利是否存在。
❌ Choice D (形式要求):
陪审团请求不需要必须包含在诉讼文书（如起诉状或答辩状）中。它可以作为一份单独的文件 (Separate Document) 提交，只要它是书面的并已送达即可。

  2. 请求是否及时？ (关键数字：14天)
  3. 起算点是什么？ (通常是 Answer 送达之日)
如果在 Answer 送达后超过 14 天才提出请求，通常视为放弃 (Waived) 该权利。

One week later, the architect timely moved to dismiss the action for failure to state a claim; he did not file an answer. Twenty days after being served with the motion, the retailer filed and served an amended complaint that added a defamation claim based on the architect's recent statements about the retailer in a local newspaper. In the amended complaint, the retailer demanded a jury on both claims.
Has the retailer properly demanded a jury trial?

choices.A: No, because the retailer filed the demand more than 14 days after service of the motion to dismiss.
choices.B: No, because the retailer filed the demand more than 14 days after service of the original complaint.
choices.C: Yes, but on the defamation claim only, because the original complaint did not contain a jury demand.
choices.D: Yes, on both claims, because the architect had not answered the original complaint when the retailer filed the amended complaint with the jury demand.

The retailer's original complaint did not demand a jury trial. But under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 15, a party may amend its original pleading once as a matter of course (ie, without the court's permission) within 21 days after:

• serving the original pleading (eg, complaint) or

• being served with a responsive pleading (eg, answer) or motion under FRCP 12(b), (e), or (f) (eg, motion to dismiss for failure to state a claim)—whichever occurs first.

The retailer amended its complaint more than 21 days after serving the original complaint. However, the amendment occurred within 21 days of the retailer being served with the architect's motion to dismiss for failure to state a claim. Therefore, the amendment—which added a defamation claim and jury trial demand—was timely and permissible.

And under FRCP 38, a written jury trial demand on any triable jury issue is timely when the demand is:

• served on the other parties no later than 14 days after the last pleading directed to the issue is served (Choices A & B) and

• filed with the court within a reasonable time after service of the jury trial demand.

An answer is typically the last pleading directed at the triable jury issue. Since the architect had not filed an answer when the retailer filed and served the amended complaint that demanded a jury trial, the demand was proper. Therefore, the retailer is entitled to a jury on both claims (Choice C).

该零售商是否已妥当地提出了陪审团审判请求？

zh-choices.A: 否，因为零售商在驳回动议送达后超过14天才提交请求。
zh-choices.B: 否，因为零售商在原始起诉状送达后超过14天才提交请求。
zh-choices.C: 是，但仅限于诽谤诉求，因为原始起诉状中未包含陪审团审判请求。
zh-choices.D: 是，对两项诉求均有效，因为在零售商提交包含陪审团审判请求的修改后起诉状时，建筑师尚未对原始起诉状作出答辩。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考题解析

Civil Procedure | Jury Demand
正确答案：D

是的，对两项诉求均有效。

本题考查的是联邦民事诉讼中诉状修改 (Amendment of Pleadings) 与 陪审团审判请求 (Jury Demand) 的时间规则交互。

核心考点解析

要理解为什么选 D，我们需要拆解两个关键的《联邦民事诉讼规则》(FRCP)：

  • FRCP 15(a) - 当然修改权 (Amendment as a Matter of Course)
  • FRCP 38(b) - 陪审团请求的时限 (Timing of Jury Demand)
1 修改诉状是否有效？(FRCP 15)

根据 FRCP 15(a)(1)(B)，如果原告收到根据 Rule 12(b) 提出的动议（如本题中的 Motion to Dismiss），原告有 21天 的时间可以“当然地”（即无需法院许可）修改一次诉状。

本题中，零售商在收到驳回动议后 20天 提交了修改后的起诉状 (Amended Complaint)，因此修改是及时且有效的。

2 陪审团请求是否及时？(FRCP 38)

根据 FRCP 38(b)，陪审团审判的书面请求必须在“针对该争议点的最后一份诉状 (Last Pleading Directed to the Issue)”送达后 14 天内提出。

这里的关键在于理解什么是“最后一份诉状”：

  • 通常情况下，被告的答辩状 (Answer) 是针对起诉状中事实争议的最后一份诉状。
  • 在本题中，被告从未提交答辩状，而是直接提交了驳回动议 (Motion to Dismiss)。
  • 注意： 动议 (Motion) 不是诉状 (Pleading)。
3 结论综合

由于被告尚未提交答辩状 (Answer)，针对原始欺诈诉求 (Fraud Claim) 的“最后一份诉状”尚未出现，因此 14 天的倒计时从未开始（或者说被修改后的诉状重置了）。

当零售商提交修改后的起诉状并包含陪审团请求时，这不仅对新增加的诽谤诉求 (Defamation Claim) 有效，对原始的欺诈诉求也有效，因为针对这两个诉求的“辩论阶段” (Pleading Stage) 均未结束。

为什么其他选项是错的？

  • 选项 A & B (No): 错误。它们假设陪审团请求必须在原始起诉状或动议送达后14天内提出。但规则是看“最后一份诉状”（通常是 Answer），而 Answer 还没出现。
  • 选项 C (Yes, but only defamation): 这是一个常见的陷阱。如果被告已经提交了答辩状，然后原告才修改诉状增加新诉求，那么原告确实只能就“新诉求”请求陪审团（旧诉求的权利已因过期而放弃）。但本题中被告未提交答辩状，所以原告没有放弃任何权利。
💡 MBE 提分技巧

一定要区分 Pleading (诉状) 和 Motion (动议)！

在计算 FRCP 38 的 14 天期限时，只有 Pleading（如 Complaint, Answer, Reply）算数。Rule 12(b)(6) Motion to Dismiss 只是一个动议，它会暂停提交 Answer 的截止日期，但它本身不是 Pleading。只要 Answer 还没出，陪审团请求的窗口通常就是敞开的。

正确答案：A

法院不会批准作废动议，因为制造商（原告）在规定的时限内适当地提出了陪审团审判请求。

核心考点：FRCP 38 (Jury Right)

根据《联邦民事诉讼规则》第38条 (Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 38)，陪审团审判请求的提出必须遵循严格的时间限制：

  1. 一般规则 (General Rule): 必须在针对该争议点的最后一份诉答文书 (Last Pleading) 送达后 14天 内提出书面请求。
  2. 特定争议点规则 (Specific Issues): 如果一方仅就特定争议点（如本题中的 Damages）提出请求，另一方有权在收到该请求送达后的 14天 内，就其他或所有争议点提出陪审团审判请求。
本案时间线分析
起诉
制造商提交诉状 (Complaint)。
未包含陪审团请求。
答辩
公司送达答辩状 (Answer)。
包含仅针对损害赔偿 (Damages) 的陪审团请求。
关键节点
10天后：制造商送达书面请求，要求对所有争议点进行陪审团审判。

分析结论： 制造商的请求是在公司送达其有限请求后的10天内提出的。这完全符合 FRCP 38(c) 规定的 14天窗口期。因此，该请求是及时的 (Timely)。

  • 选项 B (30天): 错误。法律规定的期限是14天，而非30天。
  • 选项 C (诉状未包含): 错误。虽然在诉状中提出请求是常见做法，但并非必须。只要在最后一份相关诉答文书（通常是答辩状）送达后14天内提出即可。
  • 选项 D (不及时): 错误。如上所述，10天小于14天，因此是及时的。

在处理 Jury Demand 问题时，请牢记 "14天" 这个数字。

特别注意：如果一方只“挑食”（只要求审理部分问题），另一方有权在14天内要求“全席”（审理所有问题）。这是为了防止一方通过选择性地使用陪审团来获得战术优势。

questions.question:
A firm incorporated and headquartered in State A sued its competitor from State B in a State A state court. The firm sought $100,000 for the competitor's defamatory statements about the firm's business practices. The complaint did not include a jury demand. Under State A law, a party must request a jury trial in its initial pleading or the right to a jury is waived.
Fifteen days after the competitor served its answer, the competitor removed the case to federal court on the basis of diversity jurisdiction. Ten days after being served with the notice of removal, the firm served a written demand for a jury trial.
Which of the following findings will the court likely make regarding the firm's demand?

choices.A: The firm preserved its right to a jury trial by asserting a legal claim in the complaint.
choices.B: The firm preserved its right to a jury trial by timely serving its demand for a jury.
choices.C: The firm waived its right to a jury trial by failing to assert the demand in state court.
choices.D: The firm waived its right to a jury trial by serving the demand more than 14 days after service of the competitor's answer.

*If the forum state does not require a jury trial demand, the parties need not make such a demand unless the court orders them to do so.

All civil litigants in federal court have the constitutional right to a jury trial for any legal claim in which the amount in controversy exceeds $20. A party generally preserves this right by demanding a jury trial within 14 days after the last pleading (usually the defendant's answer) is served. However, in an action removed from state to federal court, a party preserves this right by either:

  • demanding a jury trial in state court before removal or
  • serving a jury trial demand within 14 days after filing or being served with the notice of removal—so long as all necessary pleadings (ie, the complaint and answer) had been served before removal.*

Here, the firm did not demand a jury trial in state court before the competitor removed the case to federal court. However, the complaint and answer were served before removal and the firm timely served its demand for a jury trial 10 days after being served with the competitor's notice of removal. As a result, the federal court will likely find that the firm preserved its jury trial right (Choices C & D).

*If the necessary pleadings were not served before removal, then the general deadline for demanding a jury—ie, 14 days after the last pleading is served—applies.

(Choice A) The firm has the right to a jury trial because its complaint asserted a legal claim—ie, a claim that seeks a monetary remedy—in which the $100,000 amount in controversy far exceeds the $20 threshold. However, the firm may only exercise this right if it made a timely demand.

📌 Educational Objective

In a removal action, a party preserves its right to a jury trial by (1) demanding a jury in state court before removal or (2) serving a jury trial demand within 14 days after filing or being served with the notice of removal, so long as all necessary pleadings had been served before removal.

  • 9 Charles Alan Wright et al., Federal Practice and Procedure § 2319 (3d ed. 2020) (explaining how to properly demand a jury trial in an action removed from state to federal court).

在竞争对手送达其答辩状十五天后，该竞争对手以多元管辖权为由，将案件移送至联邦法院。在收到移送通知十天后，该公司送达了一份要求陪审团审判的书面请求。

关于该公司的请求，法院可能会做出以下哪项裁定？

zh-choices.A: 该公司通过在起诉状中主张一项法律请求，保留了其要求陪审团审判的权利。
zh-choices.B: 该公司通过及时送达其陪审团审判的请求，保留了其要求陪审团审判的权利。
zh-choices.C: 该公司因未能在州法院主张该请求，而放弃了其要求陪审团审判的权利。
zh-choices.D: 该公司因在竞争对手的答辩状送达超过14天后才送达该请求，而放弃了其要求陪审团审判的权利。

questions.zh-explanation:
MBE 考点解析

Civil Procedure: Jury Trials in Removed Cases
正确答案：B

该公司通过及时送达其陪审团审判的请求，保留了其权利。

⚖️ 核心法律规则 (FRCP 81(c)(3)) 当案件从州法院移送 (Removed) 至联邦法院时，如果所有必要的诉状（Complaint 和 Answer）在移送前已经送达，当事人可以通过以下方式保留陪审团审判权：

在收到移送通知 (Notice of Removal) 后的 14天内，送达陪审团审判的书面请求。

📅 案件时间轴分析

州法院阶段
原告起诉，被告答辩 (Pleadings Closed)。
注：原告此时未提出陪审团请求。
答辩后第 15 天
被告将案件移送至联邦法院 (Removal)。
收到移送通知后第 10 天
原告送达陪审团审判请求 (Jury Demand)。
截止日期 (Deadline)
收到通知后第 14 天。

🔍 深度解析

1. 联邦规则优先于州规则的“失效”
虽然根据A州法律，原告在起诉状中未提出请求即视为放弃（Waived），但一旦案件进入联邦系统，联邦民事诉讼规则（FRCP）即开始适用。FRCP 81(c)(3) 专门处理移送案件中的陪审团请求问题，给予了当事人一个新的机会。
2. 为什么不是选项 D (14 days after Answer)?
通常情况下（FRCP 38），陪审团请求必须在最后一份诉状（通常是答辩状 Answer）送达后14天内提出。
在本案中，移送发生在答辩状送达后的第15天，如果适用普通规则，原告已经过期了。但是，FRCP 81(c)(3) 是针对移送案件的特别规则，它重新开启了一个14天的窗口（从移送通知送达之日起算）。
3. 结论
原告在收到移送通知后的第10天提出了请求，这在FRCP 81规定的14天窗口内。因此，原告成功保留了其陪审团审判权。
🎓 考试技巧 (Exam Tip):
遇到 Removal（移送管辖）的题目，务必检查 FRCP 81 的特殊期限。不要直接套用 FRCP 38 的“答辩后14天”一般规则，特别是当移送发生在答辩之后时。记住：移送会触发一个新的 14 天窗口。

questions.subject: Civil Procedure
questions.question:
A man filed a federal diversity action against a bus company, seeking damages for injuries he had sustained in an accident while riding a bus owned by the company. The man demanded a jury trial.
After the parties' attorneys examined the prospective jurors and exercised their challenges, six jurors and two alternate jurors were chosen. During the trial, two jurors became ill and were replaced by the alternate jurors. At the conclusion of the trial, a third juror also became ill, and the court excused that juror.
The parties' attorneys stipulated to the return of a verdict from a five-person jury. The jury then deliberated and returned a verdict for the company. The man timely filed a motion for a new trial, arguing that the five-person jury was not large enough to return a verdict.
Should the court grant the motion?

choices.A: No, because the court properly excused the three jurors due to illness.
choices.B: No, because the parties stipulated to a verdict from a jury of fewer than six jurors.
choices.C: Yes, because there must be at least six jurors on a federal civil jury.
choices.D: Yes, because there must be at least 12 jurors on a federal civil jury.

questions.explanation:
Explanation

Jury pool summoned

6-12 jurors impaneled

Unanimous verdict returned

Under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure (FRCP) 48, a jury must begin with at least 6 and no more than 12 members. Each juror must participate in the verdict unless excused for good cause (eg, illness, family emergency). And unless the parties stipulate otherwise, the verdict must be unanimous and returned by at least 6 jurors. A court should grant a party's motion for a new trial if any of these requirements is not met.

Here, the jury began with 6 members and 2 alternates. During the trial, 2 jurors were excused for illness (good cause) and replaced by alternates, and a third juror was also excused for illness at the conclusion of the trial. This left 5 jurors to return a verdict. And though a verdict normally requires at least 6 jurors, the parties stipulated to a 5-person jury (Choice C). Therefore, the court should deny the man's motion for a new trial.

(Choice A) Even if jurors are properly excused for good cause, at least 6 jurors must return a verdict unless the parties stipulate otherwise.

(Choice D) FRCP 48 requires that a jury begin with a minimum of 6 jurors—not 12 (which is the maximum).

📌 Educational Objective

FRCP 48 requires that a jury begin with at least 6 and no more than 12 members. The verdict must be unanimous and returned by a jury of at least 6 members—unless the parties stipulate otherwise.

📚 References
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 48 (number of jurors and verdict).
  • Fed. R. Civ. P. 47(c) (excusing a juror for good cause).

zh-choices.B: 不应批准，因为双方当事人约定由少于六名陪审员的陪审团作出裁决。

MBE 考点解析：联邦陪审团人数

正确答案：B

法院不应批准重新审判的动议。

理由是：虽然联邦民事陪审团通常至少需要6人，但双方当事人已明确约定 (Stipulated) 接受少于6人的裁决。

核心法规：FRCP 48

本题考查《联邦民事诉讼规则》第48条关于陪审员人数的规定。该规则分为两个关键阶段：

1. 审判开始时 (Start of Trial) 陪审团必须由至少 6 名、至多 12 名成员组成。
FRCP 48(a)
*这是一个硬性规定，不能通过约定豁免。
2. 作出裁决时 (Verdict) 裁决必须由至少 6 名陪审员作出，除非当事人另有约定 (Unless the parties stipulate otherwise)。
FRCP 48(b)
本案逻辑推演
初始阶段：选定6名陪审员+2名候补。
✔ 符合 FRCP 48(a) (至少6人)。
审判中途：3名陪审员因病退出，无候补可用。剩余 5 人。
关键动作：双方律师约定 (Stipulated) 由5人作出裁决。
✔ 触发 FRCP 48(b) 的例外条款。
结果：5人裁决有效。原告不能因为输了官司就反悔。
易错项辨析
